account.comingSoon: Track your cards in Collection and check decklists in Decks.

config.missingBody: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY (see docs/SETUP.md), then restart the app.

collection.title: Collection
collection.signedOutBody: Create a free account to track every card you own — exact arts and languages included — synced across all your devices.
collection.emptyBody: Open a set and switch on “Tap to collect” to tick off the cards you own, use + on any card page, or import a list you already have.
collection.ownedAcross_one: You own {{count}} copy of this card. Any printing counts toward a deck.
collection.ownedAcross_other: You own {{count}} copies of this card. Any printing counts toward a deck.
collection.signInToTrack: Sign in to track which cards you own →
collection.collectModeHint: Tap a card to add a copy; tap − to remove one. Faded cards are ones you don’t own yet.
collection.nothingHere: No cards to show with this filter.
collection.noneOfThisCard: You don’t own this card yet. Any printing counts toward a deck.
collection.legendElsewhere: Copies of its other arts and languages

import.title: Import cards
import.intro: Paste a list or choose a CSV / text file. Each line needs a card number; quantity and language are optional.
import.examples:
4xOP01-016            (OPTCG Sim format)
2 OP01-025_p1 JP      (alt art, Japanese)
OP05-119 x3           (quantity after)
CSV with columns like: code, quantity, language
import.defaultLanguage: Language for lines that don’t say
import.defaultLanguageHint: Lines can override it with EN / JP.

modeHints.add: Add these copies to what you already own.
modeHints.set: Set each listed card to exactly this quantity (0 removes it). Cards not in the list stay as they are.
modeHints.replace_all: Your collection becomes exactly this list. Everything not in it will be removed.

import.empty: Paste a list or choose a file first.
import.nothingValid: No line in this list has a card number we recognise.
import.collectionAfter: Afterwards your collection will have {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.collectionNow: Your collection now has {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.unknownHint: These will be skipped. Check the number, the _p/_r suffix and the language (some cards exist only in Japanese).
import.noChanges: Nothing would change: your collection already matches this list.
import.afterwards: Your collection goes from {{before}} to {{after}} copies ({{printings}} printings).
import.backupTitle: This removes {{count}} copies that are not in your list.
import.backupBody: Save a backup first, so you can import it again if anything goes wrong.

cardsPage.title: Cards
cardsPage.subtitle: Every set and deck, newest release first. Search to find any card.

landing.lead: Playset is a checklist for the One Piece Card Game. Tick off every printing you own — English and Japanese, alt arts and all — then paste any decklist to see what you can build and what’s missing.
landing.sampleNote: Sample marks. Yours fill in as you collect.

own.title: Tick off what you own
own.body: Tap through any set, or paste a list or spreadsheet. Base, alt art, manga, reprints, English and Japanese: every printing is tracked, and all of them count toward your playset.

paste.title: Paste a decklist
paste.body: From OPTCG Sim or any deckbuilder. Any printing of a card fills its slot, so your alt arts count.

missing.title: See what’s missing
missing.body: What you already own for the deck, and exactly what’s missing — copy it straight into a shop order.

landing.checkTitle: Owned or missing, card by card
landing.checkBody: Four slots per card, like a playset. Marked: you own it. Red: you still need it. Alt arts and Japanese copies fill the same slots. Hold back cards sleeved in decks you’ve already built, or check with English cards only for official events.
landing.closingBody: Pick the set you’ve opened the most packs of and tick it off. It takes a few minutes, and it’s free.

decks.title: Decks
decks.subtitle: Save decklists and see what you're missing from your collection.
decks.signedOutBody: Create a free account, add the cards you own, then paste any decklist to see what you have and what you're missing.
decks.emptyBody: Paste a decklist from OPTCG Sim or any deckbuilder to check it against your collection.
decks.name: Deck name
decks.listHint: One card per line, like 4xOP01-016. Art suffixes and languages are ignored — any version counts.
decks.ignoredLines_one: {{count}} line without a card number was ignored.
decks.ignoredLines_other: {{count}} lines without a card number were ignored.

problems.noLeader: No leader card in this list.
problems.multipleLeaders_one: {{count}} leaders — a deck uses exactly one.
problems.multipleLeaders_other: {{count}} leaders — a deck uses exactly one.
problems.wrongSize_one: {{count}} card besides the leader — a deck needs exactly 50.
problems.wrongSize_other: {{count}} cards besides the leader — a deck needs exactly 50.

decks.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed. Your collection is not affected.
decks.englishOnlyHint: Ignore Japanese copies (for official English events).
